# Mastt

> > Mastt provides construction project management software, research, and free templates for capital projects, cost control, and resource planning.

Mastt offers a comprehensive platform for construction and capital project management, featuring educational content, industry research, and downloadable templates in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint formats. The platform serves project managers, construction professionals, and capital project teams with tools for budgeting, scheduling, and contract administration.

## Key Topics

- Construction project management
- Capital projects
- Cost control and estimation
- Project planning and scheduling
- Resource allocation
- Budget tracking
- Risk management
- Contract administration
- RACI matrix
- Critical path analysis
- AI data entry automation
- Project milestones
- Team alignment
- Construction scheduling
- Practical completion certificates

## Core Platform & Research

- [Construction Management Research](https://www.mastt.com/research): Free research hub on construction project management and industry trends

## Project Management Templates

- [Project Kickoff Meeting Agenda Template (Word, Excel)](https://www.mastt.com/resources/project-kickoff-meeting-agenda-template): Free kickoff meeting agenda template in Word/Excel for project launches
- [Basis of Estimate Template (Word, Excel)](https://www.mastt.com/resources/basis-of-estimate-template): Construction basis of estimate template with cost justification structures
- [Capital Project Dashboard (Word, Excel)](https://www.mastt.com/resources/capital-project-dashboard): Free capital project dashboard template for budget and schedule tracking
- [Resource Planning Template (Word, Excel)](https://www.mastt.com/resources/resource-planning-template): Free resource planning template for labor, equipment, and materials
- [Project Outline Template (Word, Excel)](https://www.mastt.com/resources/project-outline-template): Free project outline template for scope, deliverables, and timelines
- [RACI Matrix Template (Word, Excel)](https://www.mastt.com/resources/project-raci-matrix): Free RACI matrix template for clear project role assignment

## Construction Project Management Guides

- [Construction Scheduling 101: How to Keep Your Projects on Track](https://www.mastt.com/blogs/construction-scheduling): Construction scheduling basics covering methods, tools, and best practices
- [Top 5 Challenges in Construction Project Management and How to Overcome Them](https://www.mastt.com/blogs/challenges-in-construction): Solutions for top construction challenges: delays, budget, and labor issues
- [Critical Path Analysis: Definition, Purpose, and Examples in Construction Projects](https://www.mastt.com/blogs/critical-path-analysis): Critical Path Analysis (CPA) guide for construction project scheduling
- [Construction Contract Administration Manual: Best Practices and Key Guidelines](https://www.mastt.com/blogs/construction-contract-administration-manual): Best practices for construction contract administration and compliance
- [How to Track Contract Variations in Construction Projects [AUS]](https://www.mastt.com/blogs/contract-variation): Guide to tracking construction contract variations in Australia projects
- [How To Obtain a Practical Completion Certificate in Construction](https://www.mastt.com/blogs/certificate-of-practical-completion): Step-by-step guide to obtaining Practical Completion Certificate (AUS)

## Cost Management & Budgeting

- [What is a Cost Management Plan? Steps, Tools, & Tips](https://www.mastt.com/blogs/cost-management-plan): Cost management plan guide for construction budgeting and cost control
- [What a Capital Projects Fund Is and How It Works](https://www.mastt.com/blogs/capital-projects-fund): Guide to capital projects fund purpose, benefits, and financing sources

## Technology & Innovation

- [What is AI Data Entry? How AI is Transforming Manual Processes](https://www.mastt.com/blogs/ai-data-entry): How AI, OCR, and NLP automate data entry in construction workflows
